boundary_reason: Stable policy selection of 80 revisions, no source-identity truncation. Source verification is not semantic completion.

entries.source: You brought back the diamond and athame to Tannen who asked you to contact Zemekkys to ask some delicate questions.
entries.target: 你把共鸣钻石和仪式匕首带回给泰恩；他让你联系泽梅基斯，询问一些敏感问题。
高阶时空法师泽梅基斯

entries.source: A shining crystal formation charged with magical energies.
entries.target: 一簇闪耀的水晶结构，其中充盈着魔法能量。

entries.source: Have an effective defense of at least 40
Your back is as hard as stone. Each time that you are affected by a physical effect, your body hardens, making you immune to all other physical effects for 5 turns.
entries.target: 你的后背坚若磐石。当你受到物理效果影响时，你的身体会硬化，在 5 回合内对所有其他物理效果免疫。

entries.source:
Conjures up a bolt of shadowflame that moves toward the target and explodes into a flash of darkness and fire, doing %0.2f fire damage and %0.2f darkness damage in a radius of %d.
		The damage will increase with your Spellpower.
entries.target:
向目标发射一团黑暗之炎，产生爆炸并造成 %0.2f 火焰伤害和 %0.2f 暗影伤害（%d 码半径范围内）。
		伤害受法术强度加成。

entries.source: Divination allows the caster to sense its surroundings, and find hidden things.
entries.target: 侦查技能可以使施放者能侦查周围环境，搜寻隐藏的东西。

entries.source: They can harness the blight of evil, infecting their foes with terrible contagious diseases while crushing their skulls with devastating combat techniques.
entries.target: 他们可以驾驭邪恶的枯萎术，一边将恐怖的传染病散布给敌人，一边以毁灭性的战斗技巧击碎他们的头颅。

entries.source: #00FF00#The elixir has augmented your magical and mental capacity!
entries.target: #00FF00#药剂增加了你的魔法和精神能量！

entries.source:
#{bold}#"Me Likes to Club"

#{italic}#Club club club,
Grab some grub!
When hunger hits,
Me likes to club!

Little halfling,
Furry feet,
Smash his brains,
Tasty meat!

Skinny elf,
Eyes so blue,
Crush his bones,
Make elf stew!

Hairy dwarf,
Smells like dirt,
Cook him long,
Or stomach hurt!

Stupid human,
Has no fear,
Looks surprised,
When me eats his ear!

Club club club,
Grab some grub!
When hunger hits,
Me likes to club!#{normal}#
entries.target:
#{bold}#“俺爱抡大棒”

#{italic}#大棒大棒抡大棒，
抓点吃的填肚肠！
肚子饿得咕咕叫，
俺就抡起大木棒！

小小半身人，
脚毛一大把，
敲碎小脑瓜，
好肉香喷喷！

瘦瘦小精灵，
眼珠蓝晶晶，
骨头砸稀烂，
炖锅精灵羹！

矮人毛茸茸，
闻着一身土，
下锅煮久点，
不然肚子苦！

笨蛋人类汉，
一点都不怕，
俺把耳朵咬，
他就吓傻啦！

大棒大棒抡大棒，
抓点吃的填肚肠！
肚子饿得咕咕叫，
俺就抡起大木棒！#{normal}#

entries.source: I'm sorry I didn't manage to protect you and as you were about to die you... fired a powerful wave of blight.
entries.target: 抱歉，刚才我没能保护住你，而就在你快要死去的时候……你发射出了一道强大的枯萎能量波。

entries.source: The boots of a Rogue outcast, who knew that the best way to deal with a problem was to run from it.
entries.target: 这双靴子属于一位流浪的盗贼，他处理麻烦的方法就是三十六计走为上计。

entries.source: This yeek has all sorts of cloth to sell.
entries.target: 这名夺心魔出售所有种类的衣服。

entries.source: Natural abilities can go beyond mere skill. Experience the true powers of nature to learn of its amazing gifts.
entries.target: 自然能力超越了纯粹的技能。经历自然的真正力量来领略它神奇的恩赐。

entries.source:
Assume a defensive mental state.
		For one turn, you will fully block the next melee attack used against you with your telekinetically-wielded weapon and then strike the attacker with it for %d%% weapon damage.
		At talent level 3 you will also disarm the attacker for 3 turns.
		At talent level 5 you will be able to reflexively block up to one attack per turn with a %d%% chance, based on your cunning. Each trigger requires and uses 10 Psi.
		This requires a telekinetically-wielded weapon.
entries.target:
用意念进行防御。
		下一个回合，你的念动武器会完全格挡对你的第一次近战攻击，并反击攻击者造成 %d%% 武器伤害。
		技能等级 3 时你还能缴械攻击者 3 回合。
		技能等级 5 时每回合你有 %d%% 几率被动格挡一次近战攻击，并消耗 10 点灵能值。几率受灵巧加成。
		这个技能需要一把念动武器。

entries.source:
You set your mind toward a single goal: the destruction of all your foes.
		Increases the maximum amount of vim you can store by %d.
entries.target:
你将精神集中于一个目标：摧毁所有敌人。
		增加你 %d 点活力上限。

entries.source: put up to 3 of the target's runes, infusions or talents on cooldown for 3-5 turns (range %d)
entries.target: 将一个目标至多3个符文、纹身或技能打入3-5回合的冷却（范围 %d）。
法杖 增加时空抗性穿透

entries.source: Runic Golems are creatures made of solid rock and animated using arcane forces.
entries.target: 符文傀儡是由坚固岩石构成的创造物，由奥术力量驱动。

entries.source: As your shade dies, the magical veil protecting the stairs out vanishes.
entries.target: 随着你的阴影死去，保护出口楼梯的魔法护罩消失了。

entries.source:
When you kill an enemy, their death forms a cursed magical pattern on the ground. This creates a circle of radius %d which blinds enemies and deals them %0.2f light damage, while giving you %d positive energy per turn. The circle lasts for %d turns.
							The damage will increase with your Spellpower.
							The duration of the circle can be increased by a critical hit.
							The blind chance increases with your Spellpower.
							You can activate this talent to draw the pattern in your own blood, creating it underneath you at the cost of %d%% of your maximum life.
entries.target:
当你杀死敌人时，死亡会在地面上形成一个魔法咒印。产生一个半径 %d 的法阵，每轮会致盲敌人并造成 %0.2f 光系伤害，同时给予你 %d 正能量。法阵持续 %d 回合。
							伤害受法术强度加成。
							持续时间可以暴击。
							致盲概率受法术强度加成。
							你可以主动使用这一技能，支付 %d%% 最大生命，用自己的鲜血在脚下绘制咒印。
你的反魔法技能打断了 %s。

entries.source: All the tools to torment your foes.
entries.target: 用尽一切办法折磨你的敌人。

entries.source: TOO SLOW, HAMBRAIN. ELIXIR'S MADE ALREADY, AND SOMEBODY ELSE WALKED OFF WITH THE REWARD. IF YOU'RE FEELING SORRY FOR YOURSELF, ASK WHETHER THIS IS MORE OR LESS PLEASANT THAN GETTING APPRECIABLE CHUNKS OF YOUR ANATOMY BLASTED CLEAN OFF YOUR BODY THIS MORNING. THAT'S RIGHT. BYE.
entries.target: 太慢了，蠢蛋，药剂我已经做好了。已经有人来拿走了奖励。如果你觉得失望，告诉自己这是否比一早上被从你身上炸烂一大块要好。就是这样，再见。

entries.source: The Spellblaze was followed by the Age of Dusk, when disease was rife and civilisation collapsed. Necromancers and fell sorcerers took advantage of the chaos to spread their vile deeds.
entries.target: 魔法大爆炸之后到来的是黄昏纪，那是一个疫病肆虐文明溃败的时代。死灵法师和一些堕落法师利用当时的混乱来散播他们的恶行。

entries.source: %s raises %s and sends out a burst of light!
Activate the rune to teleport randomly in a range of %d with a minimum range of 15.
entries.target: 激活这个符文随机传送 %d 码范围内位置，至少传送 15 码以外。

entries.source: #LIGHT_RED#Quest '%s' is failed!#WHITE#(Press 'j' to see the quest log)
entries.target: #LIGHT_RED#任务“%s”失败！#WHITE#（按 J 键查看任务日志）

entries.source:
You enter a terrible rampage for %d turns (up to a maximum of %d turns), destroying everything in your path. Starting a rampage is instantaneous. You may also enter a rampage (50%% chance) when you are hit for more than 8%% of your max life. 
		Any talent, rune or infusion you use while rampaging becomes a distraction, and reduces the duration of the rampage by 1. Your first movement while rampaging increases the rampage duration by 1.
		Rampage Bonus: +%d%% movement speed.
		Rampage Bonus: +%d%% attack speed.
		Rampage Bonus: +%d%% mind speed.
entries.target:
你进入暴走状态 %d 回合（最多 %d 回合），摧毁路径上的一切。主动进入暴走不消耗回合；当单次受到超过最大生命值 8%% 的伤害时，也有 50%% 几率自动进入暴走。
		暴走期间使用任何技能、符文或纹身都会使你分心，令暴走持续时间缩短 1 回合；暴走期间首次移动会使持续时间延长 1 回合。
		暴走加成：+%d%% 移动速度。
		暴走加成：+%d%% 攻击速度。
		暴走加成：+%d%% 精神速度。

entries.source: Knock the target backwards with a powerful telekinetic blow.
entries.target: 使用强大的念力攻击，将目标击退。

entries.source: Black-robed Elves with a mad look in their eyes.
entries.target: 穿着黑色长袍的精灵，他们的眼中满是疯狂。
